notes.title: Nuts About Nuts 1.2.0 Update & Special Discount
notes.notes:
🎉 Exciting News! 🎉

Hello everyone, 🛠 ⚙

The 1.2.0 Update is now available! This fixes a few lingering issues in Nuts About Nuts,
adds new content to the game.

1.2.0 Update Notes:

- adjusted main menu bouncing effect
- fixup on help menu page 4 (conveyor layouts)
- replaced in-game "Main Menu" button with "World Map" button
- added UI element on how much upgrades cost
- added UI element on current money balance in the shop
- added subtext to level up UI indicating that stuff and factories have been unlocked

- 3 new machines added to the shop!

notes.title: Nuts About Nuts is finally released!
notes.notes:
🎉 Exciting News! 🎉

We're thrilled to announce that Nuts About Nuts is officially here! 🚀 Dive into our single-player and co-op factory sim where teamwork, tools, and tons of nuts machines come together to create an unforgettable gameplay experience. Get ready to master the assembly line, manufacture intricate parts, and keep the fun rolling with friends by your side. Let's get nutty! 🌰💥

Grab your copy now on Steam and start building your dream factory adventure! 🛠️

notes.title: What do you do with dirty parts?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269571/450d71afc8aa085124d68fa2c2692d8d51528a20.png[/img]

Dear potential players:
Here is a happy little update. I am still working on the game.
By now you have figured out that we manufacture parts here. This is a factory sim.
So as a bonus, I developed a system that the parts we make come out "dirty".
And what do you do with dirty parts?
You clean them!
As a result, a special machine cleans the part for us.
So we can deliver it nicely and cleanly.

-LbGamess

notes.title: New Interactive Tutorial
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269571/acd92e42e3f1bc77272270725dfbe4551499bf24.png[/img]

Dear potential players:
For the past week, I have been working on an interactive tutorial system for Nuts About Nuts. The tutorial will take place in the first play session you do in the game. It is a step-by-step guide on how to make a profit in the game and run your factory floor. This way players will learn how to play the game in a fun and interactive way. 

-LbGamess
